params.body:
Editing a vehicle that no longer exists gave a 500 (Nightwatch 27, twice this morning, one dealer). `/own-vehicles/MTAxMTI=/edit`: vehicle 10112 is that dealer's own car, deleted on 15 October 2024, reached from a two year old bookmark.

`OwnStockController::edit` asked `$vehicle?->is_complete` and then read `$vehicle->id` on the next line to open the create screen. The `?->` looks like the guard that belongs there, and covers exactly one of the two dereferences; a vehicle that is gone is also never complete, so it always walked into the second one.

A vehicle that is not there now sends the dealer back to his own list with "Voertuig niet gevonden", the same place a vehicle of another dealer already went further down the same method. The message is a different one on purpose: "your vehicle is gone" and "this one is not yours" are different news, and the deleted car is almost always his own.

- `R S1-9.9` extended with the gone-vehicle case.
- Finding `bewerken-van-een-gewiste-wagen`, resolved in this pull request.
- `EditingADeletedVehicleTest` pins the three doors side by side: deleted, never existed, another dealer's. Verified to bite: without the guard the first two fail with the exact production exception.

Full suite green, PHPStan clean.
params.title: Editing a vehicle that is gone is the list, not a 500
